Class AcademicScenarios

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.scenario.AcademicScenarios
public class AcademicScenarios extends Object
Repository of predefined Academic invalid input: '&' Research Scenarios for SwarmForge. Enables repeatable scientific observations and AI behavioral benchmarking.
Author:
Silvère Martin-Michiellot, Gemini AI Assistant
